og.alt: Documents (@pyreon/document): Write the report once. Send it as a PDF, a spreadsheet or a Slack message.

hero.alt: An invoice written once as JSX: <Document> with a <Heading> and a <Table>. render(doc, format) is called with 'pdf', then 'xlsx', then 'slack', then 'md', and each time the same tree lights up a different output: a PDF page, a spreadsheet grid, a Slack Block Kit message and a Markdown file.
